==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I had a false awakening. In the false awakening I struggled to try and remember my dreams. When I couldn't remember my dreams, I suddenly realized that I was still dreaming.

Once I realized I was still dreaming, I saw myself transform. I became a superhero surrounded by crackling pink energy. I wore a helmet over my face and a red armored suit.

Similar to yesterday's dream, almost right after this moment of lucidity my memory becomes hazy. I don't recall if I actually got the chance to do anything with my powers. The next thing I remember is my alarm going off and finally waking up.
